text: Marcus builds a GitHub Actions workflow that lints and tests every pull request to catalog-api and checkout-api.
On merge to main, the pipeline builds a container image and scans it with Trivy, blocking the build on any critical vulnerability.
A passing image gets tagged with the exact git commit SHA, so every image in ECR traces back to its source commit.
The tagged image pushes to Amazon ECR and hands off to the deployment workflow.
Next: setting up Prometheus, Grafana, and a real production error-rate alert.
